patch.summary: SaneBox migration guide: inventory → rehearse → freeze → validate integrations — grounded in researched limitations and catalogue peers.

blocks.body: Migrate to SaneBox by inventorying legacy business-communications fields, mapping them to SaneBox objects, rehearsing a freeze window, and validating Gmail, Outlook, Icloud before reopening writes.
bullets: Inventory → map → rehearse → cut over → reopen
Highest risk: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat
Success signal: primary workflow works for the pilot cohort

blocks.heading: SaneBox migration cutover playbook
blocks.body: Migrations fail from optimistic timelines — not from missing motivation.

scenarios.title: Field inventory
scenarios.body: Export legacy fields that power revenue workflows and mark must-map vs archive.

scenarios.title: Rehearsal load
scenarios.body: Run a non-prod load into SaneBox; measure match rates before the freeze.

scenarios.title: Production freeze
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes; cut over; validate Gmail; then reopen.

steps.label: Migrate when Individuals and small teams drowning in inbound email who want automatic triage outweigh migration cost
Delay if this limitation hits cutover: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat
If SaneBox mapping is poor, compare destination fit with Fastmail before moving data twice

items.title: No freeze window
items.body: Dual-writing without a freeze creates irrevocable duplicates.

items.title: Integrations last
items.body: Wire Gmail in rehearsal — not on Monday morning after cutover.

items.title: Data risk 1
items.body: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat

items.title: Data risk 2
items.body: Billing is per person with no team or family plan, so multi-user rollouts multiply cost

items.title: Data risk 3
items.body: Mailbox caps drive upgrades: 1 account on Snack, 2 on Lunch, 4 on Dinner

checklist.label: Complete field inventory for core workflows
